$schema.description: The JSON schema of this file.

mcp.description: Configuration for the MCP. You can choose whether it is enabled, which transport to use: 'local' (default) or 'remote', and how the tools are exposed to the model ('direct' by default).

instructions.description: Configuration for the automatic instructions injection in the system prompt. You can choose if it should be enabled or not.

enabled.description: It can be either a boolean or an array containing the skills that you want to enable

skills.description: Configuration for the skills. You can choose if they should be enabled or not, or specify an array of skill names to enable only specific skills.
